tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search full-release browser games by title or gameplay. Returns canonical play-page links and related primary guides. Empty query lists games alphabetically; results do not represent popularity.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Get the factual description, complete published instructions, controls, supported devices, and primary guide links for one game. Accepts a title, public slug or stable catalog ID.

tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description: Find browser games matching stated gameplay preferences and device. Each result explains its catalog matches. Matches catalog text and optional exact category/tags; ordering is relevance then title, not popularity or an editorial rating.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find published FoolFish Games guides and articles by topic. Optional game slug matches the primary game only; linked recommendations are not counted as walkthroughs.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the published guide or article text, section headings, tips and canonical links. Use search_guides to find its slug first.
